svg.title: GD building catalogue — painterly front elevations
svg.desc: Concept sheet: every catalogue building type as a painterly front elevation at labelled scale, grouped by district, with 180 cm figure and 200 cm bay tick in each panel, a back-alley comparison strip and a height ladder. Concept art only.
svg.text: Painterly front elevations of every catalogue type, grouped by district. Light 3/4 depth cue; numbers match the art bible catalogue (no #33: docks removed).
Each panel: type number, functional label, overall height H, a 180 cm figure and a 200 cm bay tick. Round arches everywhere except the cathedral.
10 m at 20 px = 1 m (all types unless noted)
10 m at 8 px = 1 m (Town Hall, Cathedral, Auction rotunda, Library)
cream plaster, pale dressed stone, old tile; banners red/gold, neutral motifs
west front; towers 44 m, flèche 58 m; only building with pointed arches + rose
round-arched colonnade, clock tower 36 m, hip roof
round-arched arcade, tiled lean-to, stone base
cream bays over stone, jetty, old tile
ochre plaster, dark oak, clay tile; awnings and forge are the only vivid accents
planked bays, forge hood, stone stack

circular basin, pedestal, two stone bowls
stone ring, oak posts, tile hood, rope
cream and restrained stone; lead-grey dome — never gold, never a needle
Ø28 m drum, broad 30 m dome, small lantern 34 m
stone bays, narrow iron door, round arch
outside the south wall; 280 cm storeys

drawn with the same type drawings as above, 4 px = 1 m
palette.json swatches only; illustration light never baked into base colour
· Setout: G = 10 cm, B = 200 cm bay. Storeys 320 cm (slums 280 cm). Doors 100 × 210 cm. Domestic roofs 50°, tower caps 60°. Eaves and front-only jetties 40 cm. People 180 cm.
· Arches: round on civic buildings, library, all gates and the strongroom. Pointed arches, tracery, pinnacles and the rose window belong to the cathedral only.
· Auction rotunda: Ø28 m drum (22 m), broad lead-grey dome to 30 m, small lantern to 34 m. Never gold, never a needle. 16 shared dome wedges.
· Height ladder: slums 3.5–7 · trade 9–16 · gates 15–18 · library tower 30 · auction lantern 34 · Town Hall clock 36 · cathedral towers 44 / flèche 58 m.
· Back alleys run behind block rows in every district: narrow, dark, run-down (smoked oak, patched/stained plaster, puddled setts, refuse, broken crates, moss). Fronts stay warm and kept.
· Signs and banners: blank sign silhouettes; neutral diamond / chevron banners; no in-world lettering. Captions on this sheet are review labels only. No docks anywhere.
· LOD: domestic types share facade/roof modules (≤3 material slots); landmarks keep caps, towers and flèche at all distances; gates never close at far LOD; bridges keep arches open.
· Each preset is a type example; narrow plots use bay + 10 cm closure assembly, never a resized door. Shading on this sheet is illustration light only — never bake it into base colour.
